headlines.description: Dwight Freeney stripped the ball from Teddy Bridgewater with 5 seconds to play, clinching a win and a playoff spot for Arizona in a win over Minnesota on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeney seals Cards' win over Vikings, playoff spot

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw for 300 yards and a touchdown as the Washington Redskins hung on to beat the Bears 24-21 on Sunday after Chicago's Robbie Gould missed yet another late field goal.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins, Redskins beat Bears for first road win

headlines.description: Andy Dalton hurt his right thumb and the Pittsburgh Steelers roughed up backup AJ McCarron while pulling away to a 33-20 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers get 33-20 win over Bengals, who lose QB Dalton

headlines.description: Johnny Manziel shook off a first-half interception and sideline meltdown by throwing a TD pass in his first start since being benched for off-field antics as the Browns defeated the 49ers 24-10.

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: The Kansas City Chiefs kept the San Diego Chargers out of the end zone twice in the final seconds Sunday, preserving a 10-3 victory for their seventh consecutive win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs' goal-line stand preserves victory over Chargers

events.name: Detroit Lions at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Todd Gurley ran for 140 yards and two second-half touchdowns, and the St. Louis Rams ended a five-game losing streak with a 21-7 victory over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams break slump with win over Lions

events.name: Tennessee Titans at New York Jets

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick threw three touchdown passes and New York's stingy defense stifled Marcus Mariota and the Titans' offense for most of the game as the Jets cruised to a 30-8 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fitzpatrick, defense lead Jets to victory over Titans

headlines.description: Caleb Sturgis kicked a 30-yard field goal with 3:26 left, Ed Reynolds intercepted Tyrod Taylor's pass in the final minutes, and the Philadelphia Eagles beat the Buffalo Bills 23-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sturgis kicks 3 field goals as Eagles beat Bills

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw a pair of touchdown passes to Marques Colston, and the New Orleans Saints stopped a four-game losing streak with a 24-17 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees, Saints beat Buccaneers to end 4-game skid

headlines.description: Cam Newton added to his MVP resume, completing 15 of 21 passes for 265 yards and three touchdowns, and the unbeaten Panthers defeated the Falcons 38-0 on Sunday to clinch a playoff bye.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Panthers pound Falcons, clinch first-round bye

headlines.description: Blake Bortles threw for three touchdowns and ran for a score as the Jaguars beat Indianapolis 51-16 on Sunday to end the Colts' 16-game winning streak in the AFC South.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars rout Colts, ending Indy's AFC South streak

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw five touchdown passes, three to Doug Baldwin, and the Seattle Seahawks wore down the injury-depleted Baltimore Ravens 35-6 on Sunday for their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson throws 5 TD passes as Seahawks beat Ravens

headlines.description: Khalil Mack had five sacks of Brock Osweiler, including one in the end zone for a safety, and Derek Carr bounced back from an awful first half to lead the Oakland Raiders past the Denver Broncos
headlines.shortLinkText: Mack, Carr lead Raiders over Broncos 15-12

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Eddie Lacy ran for 124 yards and a touchdown, fellow running back James Starks added two scores and the Green Bay Packers beat the Dallas Cowboys 28-7 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lacy, Starks lead Packers past Cowboys 28-7

events.name: New England Patriots at Houston Texans

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 226 yards and two touchdowns and the New England Patriots snapped a two-game skid and clinched a playoff spot with a 27-6 win over the Houston Texans on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots rebound with rout, seal spot in playoffs

events.name: New York Giants at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Odell Beckham Jr.'s two touchdowns, including one on an 84-yard catch to break a fourth-quarter tie, helped the Giants forge a three-way tie atop the NFC East with a 31-24 win over the Dolphins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning-Beckham duo puts Giants in tie atop East
